prompt_fragment: This asset is a card face. Compose for a vertical 3:4 frame with a strong focal subject and room for card framing or overlay treatment.
raw_description:
Upper half: a Wake-Singer mid-ritual over the Corpse Current. She sings
into the deep; the water around her visibly distorts from invoked
pressure-magic. Warm copper-scented current rising from below; the faint
outline of something vast and two-miles-long in the abyssal shadow
beneath her — the dead god. Lower half: warm dark surface for text,
ghosted silhouette watermark. Warm cream parchment frame.
formatted_prompt: Editorial ink-and-watercolor illustration, richly pigmented, game-poster saturation on aged cream parchment with faint foxing at the edges. Vertical 3:4 composition: a massive adult orca Wake-Singer occupies the upper two-thirds of the frame, ascending through open ocean in mid-ritual, fluke angled downward into darkness. Blue-black hide marked with ivory ritual scar-lines across the snout and flanks; carved resonance-chambers along the body's sides pulse with dense gravitational distortion, water bending and warping visibly around her in concentric pressure-rings. Copper-warm Corpse Current rises from below — vivid amber-orange thermal bloom — while in the abyssal shadow beneath, a faint two-mile silhouette of the dead god lies half-visible, suggested in deep navy and midnight indigo. The practitioner's open jaw points downward, mouth agape in subsonic song; fine nib-pen linework traces the ivory scars, watercolor fills rich in ocean deep-blue (#1E4A85) and shelf light-blue (#4A90C5). The lower third dissolves into warm dark water, parchment-cream tones bleeding in for text overlay space, ghosted dead-god watermark faint beneath. Lighting from the copper current below casts amber rim-light across the orca's belly; deep cold shadow overhead. Salt-crust texture along the hide edges.
